meaning: The shared Frege-Geach data refute the occasion reading of emotivism. It composes FREGE-GEACH-NAIVE-EMOTIVISM-INVALIDATES-MORAL-MP (imported, invariant 17): were naive emotivism true, Geach's moral modus ponens would be invalid; it is valid (a datum the expressivists accept too). This refutes naive emotivism only. Constant-meaning expressivism (Blackburn, Gibbard) escapes the equivocation charge (EXPRESSIVISM-CONSISTENT-WITH-GEACH-VALIDITY). The refutation is relative to the shared data, each a sourced but undefended premise.
